'''Lara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. During the [[war against Zakuul]] she traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance]]. She was assigned to the [[Force Enclave]] branch under [[Sana-Rae]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
